description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the variable N and the AUC percentage. The x-axis is labeled "N" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape, with data points recorded at x-values of 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20. A solid blue line with open circle markers begins at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 94, rises to a peak near 98.5 at x=5 and x=10, and then steadily declines to end at (20, 94). A solid red line with open square markers starts at (1, 87), rises to a peak of approximately 98.5 at x=10, and then decreases to end at (20, 91). A solid orange line with open diamond markers starts at (1, 84), rises steadily to a peak of approximately 95 at x=15, and slightly decreases to end at (20, 94.5). A solid green line with open star markers begins at (1, 86.5), increases steadily to a peak of approximately 94.5 at x=15, and declines to end at (20, 92). Finally, a solid purple line with open inverted triangle markers starts at (1, 79.5), remains relatively flat to (5, 79), rises sharply to a peak of approximately 96.5 at x=10, and then declines to end at (20, 82.5).
